# KaTeX 0.16.22

The `dist/`, `LICENSE`, and `package.json` files are copied without modification
from the official KaTeX npm package, version 0.16.22. They render the lecture's
math locally, without a CDN connection or a floating `@latest` dependency.

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/-/katex-0.16.22.tgz

Archive SHA-256:
`e9e0d167db3175481cbadaff38e8d90b130f6a3ddb451a47e43c577fd511f365`

This update reused the identical archive already in the course at
`03_nn_autograd/katex-0.16.22.tgz`. The package manifest was checked for the
`katex` name and `0.16.22` version before extraction. KaTeX is MIT licensed;
see `LICENSE`.
